hooks.command: cd ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} && { { [ -d node_modules ] && [ ! package-lock.json -nt node_modules/.package-lock.json ]; } || npm install --ignore-scripts; } && { { [ -f dist/index.js ] && [ -z "$(find package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json src -newer dist/index.js -print -quit 2>/dev/null)" ]; } || npm run build; }
